W A S Dwalk, Shift to run, Space to jump

Under waterswim where you look, Space up, C down, Shift fast

1 - 9   0go to a spot in the place you are in, 1 its door; 0 the middle of the white room
Bthe book: QE or the wheel turn its pages, a click steps into one
M   H   Escsound, frame statistics, this menu
Left thumbwalk: a stick appears under it; push it past its ring to run
Right thumbdrag to look around

Arrowjump; hold it to rise under water
Bookthe book: the arrows turn its pages, a tap steps into one

Credits

The underwater world behind the blue portal is Abyssal Garden by Maksymilian Dendura, used under the MIT License. The stars over the moon are placed from the Yale Bright Star Catalogue. Grotto assets by Poly Haven and tevy (CC0). The lighthouse's and the alley's surfaces are photographs from Poly Haven and ambientCG, their sound recordings from Freesound and BigSoundBank (all CC0).

Nephele combines four observations in a spherical panorama, with a simulated foreground. Adapted under CC BY 4.0.
